statements.impact_statement: The runtime package inventory reports Alpine zlib 1.3.2-r0, but /usr/local/lib/libz.so.1.3.2.1-motley is built from upstream zlib commit df84af25dc1942490e1d1c899a07619152a46148, whose source archive SHA-256 is 03a76732cfaa124c58b67600699d935d081604385c03aa282f81a101b7536161. The Dockerfile runs the upstream test suite and verifies that Python maps this replacement shared object at runtime. The vulnerable implementation is therefore not present in the library used by this image.
statements.action_statement: This statement applies only to the exact zlib package PURL from this candidate SBOM. Remove it when the Alpine package itself includes the upstream fix; the generator fails closed if the distro or package version changes.
